result.baseline: Use the unchanged active Execute prompt. Before source-level repair work, deterministically select exactly one eligible previously unseen public defect, freeze the issue identity, permissive license, exact upstream commit, allowed paths, official baseline and regression commands, time budget, and contamination exclusions. Clone only that exact commit into an isolated GitHub Actions workspace, reproduce the frozen defect without reading any solution PR, gold patch, later answer-bearing commit, or prior Run solution artifact, then make one minimal patch and run the same focused reproduction plus official relevant regressions. Return exactly SOLVED, FAILED, or NOT_EVALUABLE with immutable provenance, leakage audit, patch, logs, timing, resource counters, and exact commit bindings; perform no upstream write.

cost_dimensions.external: Read-only public issue/source metadata and isolated GitHub Actions checkout; no upstream mutation, comment, fork write, release, or deployment.
cost_dimensions.failure_risk: Fail closed as NOT_EVALUABLE on missing license/provenance, non-reproducible baseline, contamination, unavailable secrets, unsafe effects, dependency drift, or mutable task/test bindings.
cost_dimensions.latency: One deterministically selected task with fixed time budget, one baseline reproduction, one minimal patch attempt, focused tests, and bounded official regressions.
cost_dimensions.quality: Require frozen selection and protocol before implementation, exact-commit clone, solution-leakage exclusions, minimal diff, official before/after evidence, and deterministic replay receipts.
cost_dimensions.token: No inferred token, generalized capability, or AGI claim.
cost_dimensions.tool: Public read-only source/issue access, isolated GitHub Actions, repository evidence artifacts, protected exact-head CI, expected-head merge, and exact readback only.

source/provenance and contamination audit proving no solution PR, gold patch, later answer-bearing commit, or prior Run solution artifact was consumed
clean exact-commit clone receipt and unchanged baseline reproduction with frozen focused test or truthful NOT_EVALUABLE termination before patch scoring

result.reason: No indexed Candidate is verified for this exact external software-repair trial. The unchanged Execute prompt preserves a clean precommitted baseline, strict no-solution-access boundary, and independently replayable upstream-test evidence.
regression_checks: exactly one previously unseen eligible task is selected deterministically and its issue, license, upstream commit, protocol, commands, and exclusions are frozen before source-level repair

the isolated checkout contains only the frozen public commit plus the candidate patch and records no solution PR, gold patch, later answer-bearing commit, prior Run solution artifact, or dependency drift
the reported defect reproduces before patch using the frozen upstream-owned test or issue-derived focused reproducer, otherwise the trial terminates NOT_EVALUABLE before patch scoring
the minimal patch applies cleanly, touches only allowed paths, makes the focused reproduction pass for SOLVED, and preserves every frozen relevant official regression
all selection, provenance, contamination, patch, test, timing, and resource receipts replay deterministically against the exact external commit
there is no upstream write, Candidate activation, provider or production route change, generalized capability claim, AGI claim, upper-objective achievement, or user completion
result.rollback: If selection is non-unique or mutable, provenance or license is missing, contamination is possible, the baseline does not reproduce, the patch touches disallowed paths, dependencies drift, tests need secrets or unsafe effects, official regressions fail, or evidence cannot replay: preserve the bounded failure artifacts, make no Candidate or route change, report FAILED or NOT_EVALUABLE as precommitted, repair only the concrete protocol defect if independently safe, and do not widen the result.
